title: CDDO-Me Overcomes Gefitinib Resistance in NSCLC by Targeting the Src/STAT3 Axis to Induce Apoptosis and Pyroptosis.
authors: Li, Tongtong; Du, Weiyu; Wang, Ruoxian; Yu, Xudong; Zhang, Bing; Wang, Wenjuan; Xu, Jiahui; Cao, Hui; Tang, Dongtong; Liu, Ning
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CDDO-Me克服非小细胞肺癌吉非替尼耐药，聚焦Src/STAT3信号通路与凋亡/焦亡，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Patients with EGFR-mutant non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) develop acquired resistance to epidermal growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor (EGFR-TKI), limiting the durability of targeted therapy. Bardoxolone methyl (CDDO-Me) has been reported to exert anti-inflammatory and anti-cancer activities. However, its role in acquired EGFR-TKI resistance remains unclear. Here, we found that CDDO-Me significantly enhanced sensitivity of resistant NSCLC cells to gefitinib, with combination index analysis confirming a synergistic interaction between CDDO-Me and gefitinib. Mechanistically, CDDO-Me induced mitochondrial dysfunction and reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation, thereby activating Caspase-3 mediated apoptosis and GSDME-dependent pyroptosis, as evidenced by increased lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) release. Network pharmacology and molecular docking analyses identified Src as a potential target of CDDO-Me. Cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) confirmed cellular engagement between CDDO-Me and Src, and Western blot analysis showed that CDDO-Me suppressed Src/STAT3 signaling. Consistently, Src knockdown reduced the inhibitory effect of combined CDDO-Me and gefitinib treatment on colony formation and attenuated changes in apoptosis and pyroptosis regulatory proteins induced by the combination treatment. Collectively, these findings suggest that CDDO-Me enhances gefitinib sensitivity by targeting Src and suppressing Src/STAT3 signaling, leading to apoptosis and pyroptosis in gefitinib-resistant NSCLC cells. This study provides mechanistic evidence for further investigation of CDDO-Me-based combination strategies for gefitinib-resistant NSCLC.
abstract_zh: 携带EGFR突变的非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者会对表皮生长因子受体酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（EGFR-TKI）产生获得性耐药，限制了靶向治疗的持久性。据报道，Bardoxolone methyl（CDDO-Me）具有抗炎和抗癌活性。然而，其在获得性EGFR-TKI耐药中的作用仍不清楚。在此，我们发现CDDO-Me显著增强了耐药NSCLC细胞对吉非替尼的敏感性，联合指数分析证实CDDO-Me与吉非替尼之间存在协同作用。机制上，CDDO-Me诱导线粒体功能障碍和活性氧（ROS）积累，从而激活Caspase-3介导的凋亡和GSDME依赖的焦亡，这通过乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）释放增加得到证实。网络药理学和分子对接分析将Src确定为CDDO-Me的潜在靶点。细胞热位移分析（CETSA）证实了CDDO-Me与Src之间的细胞结合，Western blot分析显示CDDO-Me抑制了Src/STAT3信号通路。一致地，Src敲低降低了CDDO-Me和吉非替尼联合处理对集落形成的抑制效果，并减弱了联合处理诱导的凋亡和焦亡调节蛋白的变化。总之，这些发现表明CDDO-Me通过靶向Src并抑制Src/STAT3信号通路增强吉非替尼敏感性，导致吉非替尼耐药NSCLC细胞发生凋亡和焦亡。本研究为基于CDDO-Me的联合策略在吉非替尼耐药NSCLC中的进一步研究提供了机制证据。
